source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of propositional equivalence (PDF 29-30).

blocks.text: Propositional equivalence batati hai ke do mantiqi expressions kab hum-maani hain. Mukhtalif dikhne wale expressions wahi nateeja de sakte hain. Barabari truth tables se jaanchi jati hai: agar do expressions ki har soorat mein truth value aik ho to woh equivalent hain. Kitab barabari ko teen ufuqi lakeeron wali alamat se likhti hai, jo 'equivalent hai' parhi jati hai.
Misal: exclusive OR do tareeqon se

Expression 1, (A AND NOT B) OR (B AND NOT A), Expression 2, (A OR B) AND (NOT A OR NOT B), ke equivalent hai. Dono bilkul tab sach hain jab A aur B mein se aik sach ho lekin dono nahi, jise exclusive OR (XOR) kehte hain (Fig 2.6).

blocks.alt: Box jo batata hai ke do propositional expressions mantiqi taur par barabar (equivalent) hain: Expression 1, (A AND NOT B) OR (B AND NOT A), aur Expression 2, (A OR B) AND (NOT A OR NOT B), dohre teer se jure; dono unhi suraton mein sach hain (XOR). Venn diagram mein sirf A wala aur sirf B wala hissa rangeen hai; mushtarka hissa aur bahar ka hissa khali. Truth table aur aakhri lakeer: Therefore, dono barabar hain.
blocks.caption: Figure 2.6: Do barabar (equivalent) propositional expressions, Venn diagram aur truth table se (kitab ki Figure 2.6 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Key: A AND NOT B; B AND NOT A; Neither A nor B (na A na B); A AND B (shamil nahi). Truth table ki rows (A, B, Expression 1, Expression 2): F F F F; F T T T; T F T T; T T F F.

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Venn diagram mein sirf A wala aur sirf B wala hissa dhaari daar hai: yahi XOR hai, yani A ya B mein se sirf aik sach. Kitab ne key mein 'A AND B (not included)' ka khana dhaari daar chhapa hai, halanke diagram mein A aur B ka mushtarka hissa khali hai, kyunke woh shamil nahi. Durust yeh hai ke yeh khana khali (be-rang) ho, is liye yahan khali banaya gaya hai. Truth table ke dono aakhri columns har row mein barabar hain, is liye dono expressions equivalent hain.

blocks.title: Dilchasp baat
blocks.text: Equivalent expressions mukhtalif dikh sakte hain lekin hamesha wahi nateeja dete hain; yeh pecheeda mantiq ko saada karne mein madad dete hain.

Equivalent expressions truth tables se pehchane jate hain: har expression tamam mumkin truth values par test hota hai, aur agar har soorat mein nataij milein to woh equivalent hain. Mantiqi qawaneen bhi barabari pehchanne aur expressions saada karne mein madad dete hain. Maslan De Morgan ka aik qanoon kehta hai ke NOT (A AND B) (NOT A) OR (NOT B) ke equivalent hai.

Barabari pecheeda expression ko saade se badalne deti hai, jis se waqt aur mehnat bachti hai. Programming mein saadi equivalent shartein code ko zyada kaar-amad banati aur mantiqi ghaltiyon se bachati hain, aur istidlal aur faislon ko durust rakhti hain.

blocks.prompt: Truth table se jaanchein ke kya NOT (A OR B) (NOT A) AND (NOT B) ke equivalent hai.
blocks.explanation: Rows (A, B): F F par T aur T; F T par F aur F; T F par F aur F; T T par F aur F. Columns har row mein milte hain, is liye expressions equivalent hain (yeh De Morgan ka doosra qanoon hai).

items: Equivalent: har soorat mein aik truth value, truth table se jaanch.
XOR: (A AND NOT B) OR (B AND NOT A) (A OR B) AND (NOT A OR NOT B) ke equivalent.
Barabari mantiq aur code saada karti (maslan De Morgan ke qawaneen).
